WITH source AS (SELECT "market_ranking_entries"."id" AS "id", "market_ranking_entries"."category" AS "category", "market_ranking_entries"."scope" AS "scope", "market_ranking_entries"."ranking_dimension" AS "ranking_dimension", "market_ranking_entries"."sku_code" AS "sku_code", "market_ranking_entries"."period_end" AS "period_end", "market_ranking_entries"."rank" AS "rank", "market_ranking_entries"."image_url" AS "image_url" FROM "market_ranking_entries" WHERE "market_ranking_entries"."id" IN (SELECT U0."latest_entry_id" AS "latest_entry_id" FROM "market_master_identities" U0)), preferred AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code) source.* FROM source
            ORDER BY category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code,period_end DESC,rank,id),
        chosen AS (SELECT * FROM preferred ),
        enriched AS (SELECT p.*  FROM chosen p ),
        selected AS (SELECT * FROM enriched ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selected

WITH source AS (SELECT "market_ranking_entries"."id" AS "id", "market_ranking_entries"."category" AS "category", "market_ranking_entries"."scope" AS "scope", "market_ranking_entries"."ranking_dimension" AS "ranking_dimension", "market_ranking_entries"."sku_code" AS "sku_code", "market_ranking_entries"."period_end" AS "period_end", "market_ranking_entries"."rank" AS "rank", "market_ranking_entries"."image_url" AS "image_url" FROM "market_ranking_entries" WHERE "market_ranking_entries"."id" IN (SELECT U0."latest_entry_id" AS "latest_entry_id" FROM "market_master_identities" U0)), preferred AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code) source.* FROM source
            ORDER BY category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code,period_end DESC,rank,id),
        chosen AS (SELECT * FROM preferred ),
        enriched AS (SELECT p.*  FROM chosen p ),
        selected AS (SELECT * FROM enriched ) SELECT s.id FROM selected s
        LEFT JOIN market_sku_gmv_totals g ON g.sku_code=s.sku_code
        ORDER BY COALESCE(g.gmv_total_cents,0) DESC,s.period_end,s.id LIMIT %s OFFSET %s

WITH source AS (SELECT "market_ranking_entries"."id" AS "id", "market_ranking_entries"."category" AS "category", "market_ranking_entries"."scope" AS "scope", "market_ranking_entries"."ranking_dimension" AS "ranking_dimension", "market_ranking_entries"."sku_code" AS "sku_code", "market_ranking_entries"."period_end" AS "period_end", "market_ranking_entries"."rank" AS "rank", "market_ranking_entries"."image_url" AS "image_url" FROM "market_ranking_entries"), preferred AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code,SUBSTR(period_end,1,7)) source.* FROM source
            ORDER BY category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code,SUBSTR(period_end,1,7),period_end DESC,rank,id),
        chosen AS (SELECT * FROM preferred ),
        enriched AS (SELECT p.* , CASE WHEN s.confirmation_status='confirmed'
        AND s.ai_price_type IN ('标准售价','到手价','券后价')
        AND LENGTH(s.image_content_sha256)=64
        AND s.image_content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
        AND s.confirmed_market_price_cents IS NOT NULL THEN 'confirmed'
        WHEN s.ai_image_price_cents IS NOT NULL OR s.source_price_cents IS NOT NULL
          OR s.average_transaction_price_cents IS NOT NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'missing' END price_status,
        CASE WHEN s.ai_image_price_cents IS NOT NULL AND (s.confirmation_status='ai_pending'
          OR (s.source_price_cents IS NULL AND s.average_transaction_price_cents IS NULL))
          THEN 'ai' ELSE 'non_ai' END candidate_source FROM chosen p LEFT JOIN market_price_snapshots s ON s.category=p.category AND s.scope=p.scope
        AND s.ranking_dimension=p.ranking_dimension AND s.sku_code=p.sku_code
        AND s.month=SUBSTR(p.period_end,1,7)),
        selected AS (SELECT * FROM enriched WHERE price_status<>'confirmed') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selected

        WHEN s.ai_image_price_cents IS NOT NULL OR s.source_price_cents IS NOT NULL

WITH source AS (SELECT "market_ranking_entries"."id" AS "id", "market_ranking_entries"."category" AS "category", "market_ranking_entries"."scope" AS "scope", "market_ranking_entries"."ranking_dimension" AS "ranking_dimension", "market_ranking_entries"."sku_code" AS "sku_code", "market_ranking_entries"."period_end" AS "period_end", "market_ranking_entries"."rank" AS "rank", "market_ranking_entries"."image_url" AS "image_url" FROM "market_ranking_entries"), preferred AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code,SUBSTR(period_end,1,7)) source.* FROM source
            ORDER BY category,scope,ranking_dimension,sku_code,SUBSTR(period_end,1,7),period_end DESC,rank,id),
        chosen AS (SELECT * FROM preferred ),
        enriched AS (SELECT p.* , CASE WHEN s.confirmation_status='confirmed'
        AND s.ai_price_type IN ('标准售价','到手价','券后价')
        AND LENGTH(s.image_content_sha256)=64
        AND s.image_content_sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
        AND s.confirmed_market_price_cents IS NOT NULL THEN 'confirmed'
        WHEN s.ai_image_price_cents IS NOT NULL OR s.source_price_cents IS NOT NULL
          OR s.average_transaction_price_cents IS NOT NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'missing' END price_status,
        CASE WHEN s.ai_image_price_cents IS NOT NULL AND (s.confirmation_status='ai_pending'
          OR (s.source_price_cents IS NULL AND s.average_transaction_price_cents IS NULL))
          THEN 'ai' ELSE 'non_ai' END candidate_source FROM chosen p LEFT JOIN market_price_snapshots s ON s.category=p.category AND s.scope=p.scope
        AND s.ranking_dimension=p.ranking_dimension AND s.sku_code=p.sku_code
        AND s.month=SUBSTR(p.period_end,1,7)),
        selected AS (SELECT * FROM enriched WHERE price_status<>'confirmed') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM selected
